item.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
item.description: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."

item.title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
item.description: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

item.title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
item.description: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.
